description: The weight goal the user set in Garmin Connect that was in effect over a range, with its goal range, returned as Garmin sends it. Empty ({}) when no weight goal is set, which is common. Pair with get_weight to track progress. Up to 92 days per call: pass a period (e.g. last_7_days, last_30_days, this_month) or start_date/end_date.

end_date.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. Defaults to start_date. Max span 92 days.

period.description: Named period resolved in the user's time zone (weeks start Monday). Use instead of start_date/end_date.

start_date.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. Required unless period is given.

name: get_weight_goals
title: Weight goals
